prompt: In a vibrant anime style, a bustling mountain campsite unfolds under a clear sky. On the left, a man in a red scarf stands tall, holding a metal ladle above a steaming pot. Next to him, a woman in a blue apron points at the bubbling stew inside the pot. A brown dog sits on a wooden log nearby, watching the food intently. In the center, a boy with spiky hair jumps in the air, reaching for a flying frisbee. A girl with pink ribbons looks at the boy, laughing as she holds a camera. Behind them, a large green tent is pitched firmly on the grass. To the right of the tent, an old man in a wide hat sits on a folding chair, reading a thick book. A black cat sleeps on the armrest of his chair, curled up tightly. Near the edge of the scene, a teenager in a yellow jacket hands a marshmallow stick to a small child in overalls. The child grabs the stick eagerly, eyes wide with excitement. A silver cooler rests next to the teenager, its lid slightly ajar. A backpack lies on the ground beside the cooler, unzipped and messy. A pair of hiking boots stands upright near the backpack, laces untied. A lantern hangs from a tree branch above the group, casting a soft glow. A map is spread out on a picnic table, weighted down by a water bottle. A woman in a green vest looks at the map, tracing a route with her finger. A man in sunglasses stands behind her, looking at the distant peaks. A bird perches on the top of the lantern, observing the scene below. There is no snow on the ground. There is no fire in the pit. There is no river visible in the background.
